urdu: تحریک پاکستان میں مسلمانوں کے لیے علاحدہ مملکت کا قیام کیوں ضروری سمجھا جاتا تھا؟
english: Why was the establishment of a separate state considered necessary for Muslims in the Pakistan Movement?
roman_1: Tahreek-e-Pakistan mein Musalmanon ke liye alahida mamlakat ka qiyam kyun zaroori samjha jata tha?
roman_2: Tehreek e Pakistan mein Musalmanon ke liye alag mamlakat ka qiyam kyun zaroori samjha jata tha?
roman_3: Tahreek Pakistan mein Musalmanon ke liye alhda mamlakat ka qiyam kyun zaroori samjha jata tha?
